guitar.evidence: Jimi Hendrix's white Fender Stratocaster (played upside-down/restrung for a right-handed guitar as a left-handed player) is one of the most iconic guitar associations in rock history.

tone.target: warm cranked blues amp with singing sustain

tone.summary: A warm, slightly overdriven Fender-style chain using the US Deluxe amp model, paired with a Comp for fullness and Spring reverb for vintage ambiance. The signal path emphasizes natural tube saturation and rich mids.
